# Swagger Petstore - OpenAPI 3.0 APIs
## pet
|Intent|API|Path|Source File|
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
|Update an existing pet by Id.|`updatePet`|`PUT /pet`|`./api.ts`|
|Add a new pet to the store.|`addPet`|`POST /pet`|`./api.ts`|
|Multiple status values can be provided with comma separated |`findPetsByStatus`|`GET /pet/findByStatus`|`./api.ts`|
|Multiple tags can be provided with comma separated strings. |`findPetsByTags`|`GET /pet/findByTags`|`./api.ts`|
|Returns a single pet.|`getPetById`|`GET /pet/{petId}`|`./api.ts`|
|Updates a pet resource based on the form data.|`updatePetWithForm`|`POST /pet/{petId}`|`./api.ts`|
|Delete a pet.|`deletePet`|`DELETE /pet/{petId}`|`./api.ts`|
|Upload image of the pet.|`uploadFile`|`POST /pet/{petId}/uploadImage`|`./api.ts`|
## store
|Intent|API|Path|Source File|
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
|Returns a map of status codes to quantities.|`getInventory`|`GET /store/inventory`|`./api.ts`|
|Place a new order in the store.|`placeOrder`|`POST /store/order`|`./api.ts`|
|For valid response try integer IDs with value <= 5 or > 10. |`getOrderById`|`GET /store/order/{orderId}`|`./api.ts`|
|For valid response try integer IDs with value < 1000. Anythi|`deleteOrder`|`DELETE /store/order/{orderId}`|`./api.ts`|
## user
|Intent|API|Path|Source File|
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
|This can only be done by the logged in user.|`createUser`|`POST /user`|`./api.ts`|
|Creates list of users with given input array.|`createUsersWithListInput`|`POST /user/createWithList`|`./api.ts`|
|Log into the system.|`loginUser`|`GET /user/login`|`./api.ts`|
|Log user out of the system.|`logoutUser`|`GET /user/logout`|`./api.ts`|
|Get user detail based on username.|`getUserByName`|`GET /user/{username}`|`./api.ts`|
|This can only be done by the logged in user.|`updateUser`|`PUT /user/{username}`|`./api.ts`|
|This can only be done by the logged in user.|`deleteUser`|`DELETE /user/{username}`|`./api.ts`|
